places.name: Amazon Theatre (Teatro Amazonas)
places.ai_summary: The Amazon Theatre is a stunning opera house in Manaus, showcasing the grandeur of the rubber boom era. It hosts cultural performances and offers guided tours.
places.place_tip: Attend a live performance for a unique experience.
places.address: Largo de São Sebastião, Manaus - AM, Brazil

places.name: Meeting of the Waters (Rio Negro & Solimões)
places.ai_summary: The Meeting of the Waters is a natural phenomenon where the dark waters of the Rio Negro and the sandy waters of the Solimões River flow side by side without mixing.
places.place_tip: Take a boat tour to fully appreciate the phenomenon.
places.address: Meeting of the Waters, Manaus - AM, Brazil

places.name: Anavilhanas Archipelago Cruise
places.ai_summary: The Anavilhanas Archipelago is one of the largest river archipelagos in the world, offering stunning landscapes, diverse wildlife, and serene boat cruises.
places.place_tip: Bring binoculars for birdwatching and wildlife spotting.
places.address: Anavilhanas Archipelago, Novo Airão - AM, Brazil

places.name: Manaus Opera House Tour
places.ai_summary: The Manaus Opera House, or Teatro Amazonas, is an iconic symbol of the Amazon rubber boom. The guided tour reveals its rich history and stunning architecture.
places.place_tip: Combine with a visit to the nearby Largo de São Sebastião.
places.address: Teatro Amazonas, Largo de São Sebastião, Manaus - AM, Brazil

places.name: Museu do Seringal (Rubber Museum)
places.ai_summary: The Museu do Seringal offers a deep dive into the history of rubber extraction in the Amazon. The museum is set in a former rubber plantation and provides guided tours.
places.place_tip: Combine with a visit to the nearby Adolpho Lisboa Market.
places.address: Rua Pio XII, 55 - Dom Pedro, Manaus - AM, Brazil

places.name: Janauari Ecological Park
places.ai_summary: Janauari Ecological Park is a preserved area of the Amazon rainforest, featuring diverse flora and fauna, and offering eco-tours and activities.
places.place_tip: Wear comfortable shoes and bring insect repellent.

places.name: Lake January (Piranha Fishing)
places.ai_summary: Lake January is famous for piranha fishing. Visitors can enjoy fishing tours and experience the thrill of catching these unique fish.
places.place_tip: Bring sunscreen and a hat for sun protection.

places.name: Monkey Forest Sanctuary
places.ai_summary: The Monkey Forest Sanctuary is a rescue and rehabilitation center for monkeys, offering visitors a chance to see these animals up close and learn about conservation efforts.
places.place_tip: Do not feed the monkeys; observe from a distance.

places.ai_summary: Adolpho Lisboa Market is a traditional Amazonian market in Manaus, where visitors can buy local produce, crafts, and souvenirs.
places.place_tip: Try the local fruits and street food.
places.address: Mercado Municipal Adolpho Lisboa, Manaus - AM, Brazil

places.name: Rio Negro Bridge
places.ai_summary: The Rio Negro Bridge is a stunning architectural feat, offering panoramic views of the Rio Negro and its surroundings.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited at sunrise or sunset.

places.place_tip: Bring a camera for stunning photos.
places.address: Rio Negro Bridge, Manaus - AM, Brazil

OP: "Going under the bridge.
The Rio Negro Bridge is a cable-stayed bridge over the Rio Negro, 3,595 metres (11,795 ft) in length that links the cities of Manaus and Iranduba."

places.name: Indigenous Village Experience
places.ai_summary: The Indigenous Village Experience offers a unique opportunity to learn about the culture and traditions of the indigenous peoples of the Amazon.
places.place_tip: Respect the local customs and traditions.

places.ai_summary: The Victoria Amazonica Waterlilies are giant water lilies native to the Amazon River, known for their impressive size and beauty.
places.place_tip: Visit during the dry season for better visibility.
